from itertools import combinations

result = [0, 6, 10, 8, 9, 4, 1, 11, 2, 5, 7, 3]

# Verify it's a permutation
print("Is permutation:", sorted(result) == list(range(12)))

# Verify all displacement vectors are distinct
n = len(result)
vectors = []
for i, j in combinations(range(n), 2):
    dc = j - i
    dr = result[j] - result[i]
    vectors.append((dr, dc))

print("Total vectors:", len(vectors), "(expected", 12*11//2, ")")
print("Unique vectors:", len(set(vectors)))
print("All distinct:", len(vectors) == len(set(vectors)))
print("Fixed x[3]=8:", result[3] == 8)
print("Fixed x[8]=2:", result[8] == 2)
print("\nSolution:", result)
